summary: Frontend-only verification of Poster Studio (6 governed templates incl. QRU Knowledge Card™ with factual gating) and Storyboard Studio (3 order actions incl. Full Media Kit, on-demand Render MP3, Render MP4 background pipeline). All 6 review acceptance criteria PASS.

issues: Persistent React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on data-testid='poster-template' (PosterStudio.js:76) and data-testid='storyboard-kr' (StoryboardStudio.js:98). Root cause is unchanged from iteration_56 — emergent editor injects a <span style=display:contents data-ve-dynamic='true'> around the dynamic option text at render time. Browsers strip the span inside <option>, so functionality is unaffected but a console error logs on every mount. Cosmetic/console-only.

critical_code_review_comments: StoryboardStudio.js:68-75 renderVideo polling: setInterval id `poll` is not cleared if component unmounts before completion; wrap in useRef/useEffect cleanup to prevent stale setState on unmounted component.
StoryboardStudio.js:74 catch block swallows the polling error without logging — hard to debug transient GET /product/{id} failures.
PosterStudio.js:30-32 uses .catch(() => {}) that silently drops errors; add at minimum console.error(e) for observability.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing verified KR 'What Is Governance?' (KMR-1A93CE v3).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Poster Studio dropdown has 6 templates in this exact order: process-formula-v1, data-comparison-v1, scorecard-grid-v1, illustrated-learning-v1, decoder-v1, knowledge-card-v1. knowledge-card-v1 auto-forces `factual` on and requires a KR id; leaving it blank generates the poster but status shows VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and Treasure=Return. Storyboard Studio /media-kit produces 5 products (youtube_video, promo_short, audio_lesson, teacher_presentation, student_presentation). Render MP3 (audio_lesson) took ~12s and returned a real 200 OK MP3 URL at /api/media-studio/file/{sb}/audio_lesson/mp3. Render MP4 (youtube_video) triggers a background Flagship Showcase job; in this run it ended RENDER_FAILED ('Video render needs review.') within 30s, which is honest/acceptable per the review request.

render_mp4_youtube_video.final_status_within_30s: RENDER_FAILED (acceptable per acceptance criteria — background Flagship Showcase job may end RENDERED or RENDER_FAILED)
